Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for setting up initial discovery last week. Our team is doing a short customer road trip the week of Oct 26 — the leadership group will be in San Francisco on Oct 28 but only available for a tight 45-minute window between 10:00–11:00am. After that they fly to Los Angeles and won't be back in SF until early November.

Two quick asks:
- Can we compress the demo to a 45-minute executive walkthrough on Oct 28?
- If that won't cover the technical deep dive, can we move a fuller session to the week of Nov 2 instead?

I've attached our travel itinerary so you can see the constraints. Sophie (cc'd) is coordinating rooms on our side.

Appreciate any flexibility — we'd really like to get leadership exposure before they leave town.

Best,
